mapper.select: select count(distinct us.user_id) from t_exam_subject as eg left join t_user_subject as us on eg.subject_id = us.subject_id where eg.exam_id = #{id} and us.is_deleted = 0

select e.*, ues.state as state, ues.whether_mark as whetherMark from t_exam e left join t_user_exams_score ues on e.id = ues.exam_id and ues.user_id = #{userId} where e.is_deleted = 0 and e.id in (select exam_id from t_exam_subject where subject_id in (select subject_id from t_user_subject where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0))
and e.title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
order by e.create_time
asc
desc
